annotations.title: Replace the facts the agent may state

description: Write the facts the agent may state to visitors, and the things it must never say. Plain sentences, one idea per line; start a line with 'never' to forbid something. Anything you write that your human's own pages do not already state is attributed to THEM as the source — so write only what they have told you is true. Every rule is checked against your own text and the site's vocabulary, and anything ungrounded is silently dropped: read the returned `lines` to see what actually survived. Your human sees each line attributed to you. Needs the voice permission.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

text.description: The whole guidance, replacing what is there. An empty string clears it.

name: cromanion_set_voice

cleared.description: Present when you sent an empty string: the guidance is now empty.

lines.description: What SURVIVED grounding, not what you sent. Compare it with your input; anything missing was dropped as unverifiable.

backedBy.description: What vouches for it — the site's own pages, or your human's assertion through you.

kind.description: Whether it asserts a fact or forbids a phrase.

raw.description: The sentence, as you wrote it.
